tool_schemas.name: search_wikipedia
tool_schemas.description: Searches Wikipedia for pages matching the provided query and returns up to limit results (no pagination; results are truncated to the requested limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or limit is not a positive integer, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your request exceeds the configured rate/usage limits. Returns NOT_FOUND only when Wikipedia returns no matches for the given query.

tool_schemas.name: get_article
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the full canonical content for the specified Wikipedia page title and returns the article text plus basic page metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or cannot be resolved to a single page, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed rate/usage limits. May raise FORBIDDEN if your credentials are not authorized to access the integration.

tool_schemas.name: get_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns Wikipedia’s general summary/lead for the specified page title. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or cannot be resolved to a single page, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when you exceed rate/usage limits. May raise FORBIDDEN if the integration is not enabled for your account.

tool_schemas.name: summarize_article_for_query
tool_schemas.description: Generates (or serves from cache) a query-tailored summary of the specified article and returns the derived artifact, including its current lifecycle/status when applicable; max_length controls the target length when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title or query is empty or max_length is not a positive integer when set, NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if generation/refresh would exceed your quota. Raises CONFLICT if the requested artifact cannot be regenerated because it is in a non-refreshable state under the current lifecycle rules.

tool_schemas.name: summarize_article_section
tool_schemas.description: Generates (or serves from cache) a summary for a specific section within an article and returns the derived artifact along with its status; max_length controls the target length when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title or section_title is empty or max_length is not a positive integer when set, NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist or the section_title does not match a section in the page, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if generation/refresh exceeds quota. Raises CONFLICT if a refresh is requested implicitly but the artifact is currently in a lifecycle state that refuses regeneration.

tool_schemas.name: extract_key_facts
tool_schemas.description: Extracts (or serves from cache) a list of key facts from the specified article, optionally focused on topic_within_article, and returns up to count facts with associated status/metadata when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty or count is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist (or if a non-null topic_within_article cannot be located within the article context), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if extraction/refresh would exceed your quota. Raises CONFLICT when an existing facts artifact is present but cannot transition to a refreshed state under lifecycle rules.

tool_schemas.name: get_related_topics
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of related topics for the specified article derived from the page’s links and categories, truncated to limit (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty or limit is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed rate/usage limits. May raise FORBIDDEN if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

tool_schemas.name: get_sections
tool_schemas.description: Returns the article’s section list (section titles in document order) for the specified page title (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or has no retrievable section structure, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed rate/usage limits. May raise FORBIDDEN if access to the integration is not authorized.

tool_schemas.name: get_links
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of internal links contained in the specified article (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed rate/usage limits. May raise FORBIDDEN if the integration is not enabled for your account.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists search query jobs previously created by your API key/client, newest first, with optional filtering by status and time window. Returns a paginated list including each job’s status and stored results (when succeeded). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination/filter values and FORBIDDEN if your credentials are not authorized.

query_contains.title: Query Contains
query_contains.description: Substring match against the original query string.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search query job by id, including its current status and any stored results or error message. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to your credentials) and FORBIDDEN if your credentials are not authorized.

tool_schemas.name: list_derived_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists derived artifacts previously computed for your client, with optional filtering by article, artifact_type, status, and query/section/topic keys. Returns a paginated list including lifecycle status and expiration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination and FORBIDDEN if your credentials are not authorized.

tool_schemas.name: refresh_article
tool_schemas.description: Forces a refetch of the specified Wikipedia page into the article cache, transitioning the cached article through stale->available/missing/error as appropriate, and returns the refreshed article record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, NOT_FOUND if the page cannot be resolved, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed rate/usage limits.

language.title: Language
language.description: Overrides the client default language when provided.

force.title: Force
force.description: When true, refreshes even if the cached article is available and unexpired.

metadata.name: Wikipedia Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a Wikipedia integration API that searches for articles by query and retrieves article content, summaries, sections, and links.
